name: zeng-color-picker
description: A flexible color picker, which supports (a)rgb and grayscale. You can custom the color format easily. You can also specify a file filter by language or path.

zeng-color-picker.Filter.ApplyForTheseFi.markdownDescription: A [glob pattern](https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/vscode-api#GlobPattern) that is matched on the absolute path of the document, separated by space.

zeng-color-picker.Preview.MatchPatterns.markdownDescription:
- Use `UPPER` letters (R,G,B,A,W,H,S,L) to represent hex components (red, green, blue, alpha, grayscale, hue, saturation, lightness).
- Use `{lower+i}` ({ri},{gi},{bi},{ai},{hi},{si},{li}) to represent integer (0-255) components (red, green, blue, alpha, hue, saturation, lightness).
- Use `{lower+f}` ({rf},{gf},{bf},{af},{hf},{sf},{lf}) to represent float (0.0-1.0) components (red, green, blue, alpha, hue, saturation, lightness).
- Use `{lower+%}` ({r%},{g%},{b%},{a%},{h%},{s%},{l%}) to represent percentage (0%-100%) components (red, green, blue, alpha, hue, saturation, lightness).
- Use `{hi:0~360}` to represent the hue (0-360).
- Use `{%xx}` to represent an ASCII character, with `xx` being its two-digit hex [ASCII code](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/ASCII#Character_set). (e.g. `{%7b}` -> `{`)
- Use sigh mark `!` to announce a word boundary.
- Avoid similar items, such as *RGBA* and *ARGB*, as they will confuse the detector.
- The **order** in the list matters.
- Example: `#RRGGBB!`, `!rgb({ri}, {gi}, {bi})`, `!hsla({hi:0~360}, {s%}, {l%}, {af})`

zeng-color-picker.Picker.InsertAfterPick.markdownDescription:
Same rule as `#zeng-color-picker.Preview.MatchPatterns#`.

Leave blank to let it guess, which is `recommended`.

zeng-color-picker.Picker.AdditionalLabel.markdownDescription:
When clicked, the title of the popup picker cycles through these labels (in addition to `#zeng-color-picker.Preview.InsertAfterPick#`).

Same rule as `#zeng-color-picker.Preview.MatchPatterns#`.
